message.reasoning: The user says: "start Docker on window using docker start." They want to start Docker on Windows using docker start. But docker start is used to start containers, not the Docker daemon. To start Docker service on Windows, you need to start the Docker Desktop application or the Docker Engine service. The user might want to start Docker Desktop. We can use the command to start Docker Desktop via the command line: "Start-Process -FilePath 'C:\Program Files\Docker\Docker\Docker Desktop.exe'" or "docker start" is wrong. We can instruct them to start Docker Desktop manually or via PowerShell. We can also mention that Docker Desktop must be installed. We can provide a command to start Docker Desktop via PowerShell: "Start-Process 'C:\Program Files\Docker\Docker\Docker Desktop.exe'". Or we can use "docker-machine start default" if using Docker Machine. But likely they want to start Docker Desktop. So we can give them a command. Also we can mention that docker start is for containers. So we can correct them. We can also provide a script to start Docker Desktop. Let's do that.
